The rock is not lumpy: its outline is a smooth egg because the merged balls sit inside the big central ball and never reach the outline.
The rock renders pinkish beige, not brown gray.

The flames render pale lemon yellow instead of bright orange (the glow plus the large yellow core wash them out), and the three tongues merge into one swollen mass instead of tapering apart as flames.
The flame tongues render lemon yellow, not the brief's bright orange: the glow brightens the #ff6a10/#ffa424 colours too much.
